atria.hint_usage: Write your question right after the prefix: %s How do I craft a furnace?
atria.too_long: The message is too long (max %s characters).
atria.err_no_key: Atria Dawn is not configured: no API key. Get a key in the Atria console (atr_...) and run: /atria key atr_YOUR_KEY
atria.err_auth: Atria Dawn rejected the API key (HTTP %s). Check the apiKey field in config/atriadawn.json.
atria.err_limited: Atria Dawn is rate limited or busy (%s). Try again in a minute.
atria.err_timeout: Atria Dawn did not answer in time. Try again.
atria.err_bad_reply: Atria Dawn returned an empty or invalid answer.
atria.busy: Atria Dawn is still typing her previous answer - wait a moment.
atria.cmd_empty: Type a question, for example: /atria How do I craft a furnace?
atria.cmd_reload: Atria Dawn config reloaded. API key: present.
atria.cmd_reload_nokey: Atria Dawn config reloaded. API key: NOT set - run /atria key <key> (ops) or edit config/atriadawn.json.
atria.cmd_key_hint: Usage: /atria key <key> - save the API key (ops), /atria key status - check it, /atria key clear - remove it.
atria.cmd_key_set: API key %s saved to config/atriadawn.json - no reload needed. Try it: @hello, who are you?
atria.cmd_key_invalid: This does not look like an API key (at least %s characters, no spaces). Example: /atria key atr_XXXXXXXXXXXX
atria.cmd_key_status_cfg: API key: set (%s) - stored in config/atriadawn.json.
atria.cmd_key_status_env: API key: taken from the environment variable %s.
atria.cmd_key_status_none: API key: NOT set. Get a key in the Atria console, then run: /atria key <key>
atria.about_1: %s - an AI companion living right in your chat.
atria.about_2: How to ask: start a chat message with %s, or use /atria <message>.
atria.about_3: /atria reset - forget the dialog, /atria key <key> - set the API key (ops), /atria reload - re-read config/atriadawn.json (ops).
atria.about_4: Atria Dawn remembers the last %s messages of your dialogue.
atria.about_noperm: Note: /atria key and /atria reload are for server operators; in a single-player world its owner can use them too (cheats not required).
